instruction: Candid photograph, eye-level medium shot. Inside a spacious judo gym featuring large grid windows in the background, the short-haired man (R2) sits on the left on a red mat, smiling warmly as he holds up a black smartphone. Next to him, the wavy-haired man (R1) sits on the right, looking at the screen with a cheerful smile. Both athletes wear white judo gis with black belts. Soft, diffused daylight streams through the windows, creating a bright and friendly atmosphere, highlighting the clean white fabric of their uniforms and the red training mat.
